description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aththikulama, Nuwaragampalatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110196
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration and property rights rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
